'''Dani Marcus''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Marcus began to provide voices for Pokémon during [[S13|the thirteenth season]]. Her first role was [[Marley]]. In {{aniseries|XY}}, she sang the ending themes to ''[[M17|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]'', ''[[PK26|Pikachu, What's This Key?]]'', ''[[M18|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages]]'', and ''[[M19|Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel]]''.
